description: This Java source file defines a Wear OS watch face service (`DigitalWatchFaceService`) that displays a digital clock with customizable colors, blinking colons, and supports ambient mode. It manages rendering the time, handling configuration updates via Google's Data Layer API, and reacts to system events like time zone and locale changes.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class that extends CanvasWatchFaceService to provide a custom watch face implementation.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the inner Engine class which handles rendering and logic.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine that handles drawing the watch face, reacting to system events, configuration, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes paints, formatters, and configurations for the watch face when the engine is created.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles registration and deregistration of receivers and connection to GoogleApiClient based on visibility.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout and text sizes based on whether the watch is round or square.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Adjusts rendering properties based on device display capabilities and user settings.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Invalidates the view to trigger redraw every minute in ambient mode.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts paints for ambient mode and updates display accordingly.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the time, date, and other components on the watch face canvas.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles connection to Google Play services, and initiates data fetching and listening.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles receiving configuration updates via Data Layer API.
